sources.title: SimCSE: Simple Contrastive Learning of Sentence Embeddings
sources.snippet: Abstract This paper presents SimCSE, a simple con-trastive learning framework that greatly ad-vances state-of-the-art sentence embeddings. We first describe an unsupervised approach, which takes an input sentence and predicts itself in a contrastive objective, with only standard dropout used as noise.
